Title: Show HN: Grafista – AI graphic designer built to fight slop

## Project page text (fetch status: ok)

```text
Create amazing AI designs without the effort or the cost
Generate branded and editable social media posts, presentations, flyers and more. No design knowledge or prompt skills required.
Sign up for free
One space to design everything
Create designs in any language, from quick marketing assets to text-heavy brochures.
How it works
Grafista is a content-first design platform. You add your text, images and branding and get complete designs in minutes.
1
Start with what matters, your text and images
Write, import, or generate content with AI.
2

Meet
```

## HN discussion (0 comments)

(no comments)
{"decision": "pass", "reason": "页面主要是营销口号和功能列表，关于\"Blueprints\"的描述（生成而非编辑模板、用用户内容重建参考设计）有一点不同角度，但没有说明具体机制、技术实现或可复用的洞见，也无独立验证，难以判断是否值得打断用户。"}

verdict.reasoning: The reason accurately describes the page as marketing copy plus a feature list, and correctly characterizes Blueprints as references for generation rather than editable templates. It names that concrete feature, and its point that there is no mechanism and no independent validation (zero comments) supports a pass.
